note: Single source for the three tiers (the skill and the plugin both read this file). There are only three options, short, medium and long, and no custom tier. A tier is a budget of tokens and attention: it decides how many topics become films and how many of each topic's skeleton questions a film walks. seconds is the total running time of the tier's films, a range rather than a target; going outside it gives a warning, not an error. Measured: one topic walking two questions runs about 7-8 minutes, one topic walking all four about 10 minutes, a month overview of 14 topics about 10 minutes (reference/04-production.md section 1).

short.label: 短
short.summary_en: One topic, walking two of its skeleton questions; the others stay on the skeleton screen, dimmed.

medium.label: 中
medium.summary_en: One topic in full depth, walking every skeleton question.

long.label: 長（完整）
long.summary_en: A month overview of every topic (scripts/month_film.py), plus two topics in full depth.

token_hint_note: token_hint is a rough multiplier relative to 'long', not a measurement. It depends mostly on the number of films, the number of questions walked and whether checking subagents are used. Record the session's usage when a film is delivered and recalibrate this field.

settings_keys.note: The plugin's data.json has a single field for this (following its existing flat naming). Nothing else is configurable: topics are picked automatically from the ranking, and the estimate and the choice of tier are asked in the same question.

default_note: Used when the plugin setting is unset and the user cannot be asked. When the user can be asked, the skill asks instead of relying on the default (reference/04-production.md section 1).
